title: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord
provenance: DXMT changelog v0.72 (github.com/3Shain/dxmt/releases), and since reported by a player: rhaerae (upstream#286, 2026-10-02), the Epic Games copy, Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0, KLYC-Box 0.9.39, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, DXMT, frame cap 60, rated 5 of 5. The report logged 1 minute through KLYC-Box and the reporter adds that they have played for more than three days with nothing wrong. Not run here.
notes: cloth simulation fixed (the changelog's words). One player report on an M1 Pro with the Epic copy rates it perfect on DXMT on the default engine with KLYC-Box's frame cap at 60, over several days of play. BattlEye is the multiplayer side's anti-cheat and the report does not say whether multiplayer was tried. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles
